newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-FLETCHER AIMS TO MAKE MOST OF GLAMORGAN TALENT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FLETCHER AIMS TO MAKE MOST OF GLAMORGAN TALENT.

text.p: Former Zimbabwe captain Duncan Fletcher is confident he can turn Glamorgan's talented squad into a winning combination when he becomes the Welsh county's coach next season.
Fletcher, 48, currently cricket manager at Western Province in South Africa, is to join Glamorgan on a one-year contract with an option for 1998, and is looking forward to the challenge.
"I believe I can help mould what is a very talented squad of players into an attractive, highly successful unit," said Fletcher, who coached the South Africa A team on last season's British tour.
"I have long held an ambition to become involved in county cricket and was very flattered when Glamorgan approached me.
"It will be a new challenge for me, but the role I am being asked to perform is precisely what I would have wanted,
"I am particularly looking forward to working with the existing coaches, and with captain Matthew Maynard, for whom I have a high regard."
Fletcher has been impressed by the array of talent at Glamorgan, where next season Pakistan fast bowler Waqar Younis will spearhead the attack.

"There is clearly a buzz at Glamorgan following the purchase of the Cardiff ground and the signing of Waqar Younis, and the prospect of coming over as first XI coach at this time is a very exciting one," said Fletcher.
